about: Harness profiles for scripts/run_evals.py. `argv` is one host invocation; the standalone tokens {arm} and {extra} expand to the arm's extras and the operator's --extra-arg values, {plugin_dirs} expands to one `--plugin-dir <module>` pair per principal module, and {prompt}, {model}, {workdir}, {max_turns} are substituted inside any token. An arm absent from `arms` cannot run on that profile. The default mode runs each arm in a disposable container: `container.argv` is the command inside the image (its ENTRYPOINT, if any, must exec its arguments) and the standalone token {permission} expands to `container.permission` there and nowhere else. Under --host no profile widens a tool permission: pass one with --extra-arg.

claude.note: --plugin-dir loads the generated modules for the with arm; the without arm loads none. Run from a fixture whose project settings enable no plugin.

codex.note: Codex loads the quenching-codex plugin from its own installation, so only the with arm exists here.

opencode.note: Flags from OpenCode's documented `opencode run`: `--model`, `--format json`, `--command` and `--auto` are the ones the spike H1 runs used against OpenCode 1.19.4; this profile has not been re-run against a live OpenCode since. `--auto` lives only in `container.permission`. The command surface port is spec 2038, so only the with arm exists until it lands.

omnigent.note: The with arm runs the generated Omnigent bundle of the suite's `skill` ({agent}, plugins/quenching-omnigent/agents/<id>) on --agent-harness (default opencode); the without arm is the bare harness. {agent} is refused when the bundle is missing. No permission token: the bundle's own deny-only policy governs the arm. Proven with --dry-run and a stub only; no Omnigent-hosted measurement has been run.

gateway.note: The default grader (system.ai.deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017 through the Unity Gateway). The endpoint and the credential come only from EVAL_GATEWAY_URL and EVAL_GATEWAY_TOKEN in the environment; the profile holds no host. Grader only: it has no arms. {root} and {prompt_file} exist only for the grader.
